run_grid_search_weights: run a grid search over weights to find the best combination of two dense retrieval models
run_rerank_two_predictions: rerank predictions from two dense retrieval models using weighted score combinations
run_load_passage_embeddings: load passage embeddings from pickled files in a directory and concatenate them into a single tensor
run_load_query_embeddings: load query embeddings from a pickled file in a given embeddings directory
run_read_pred_json: read and parse a JSON file containing retrieval predictions for questions and contexts
